sections.section_title: Using the GPIO pins in the RTC supply domain
sections.text_helper: Section 11.3.14 "Using the GPIO pins in the RTC supply domain" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 347.
sections.section_content:
The PC13/PC14/PC15 GPIO functionality is lost when the core supply domain is powered
off (when the device enters Standby mode). In this case, if their GPIO configuration is not
bypassed by the RTC configuration, these pins are set in an analog input mode.
For details about I/O control by the RTC, refer to Section39.3: RTC functional description. .
